title: wot-lab run
description: A run: the Action invocations an agent made at a task, in order. The dashboard replays it (Replay a run). A file holds one run, a JSON array of runs, or one run per line (JSONL).

environment.description: Name of the environment manifest in src/environments/.

task.description: Id of a record in the environment's tasks.json, which supplies initialState and goal.

initialState.description: Only read when `task` is absent. Thing id -> property values, as in a task record.

goal.description: Only read when `task` is absent. Predicates as in a task record.

items.description: One Action invocation, shaped like an optimalPlan entry. An entry with "op": "read" is a logged read and is skipped.

input.description: The WoT payload: {} for an Action that takes none, the bare value for a scalar schema.

status.description: HTTP status the harness saw. Not replayed; shown when the replay differs.

output.description: Response body the harness saw. Not replayed; shown when the replay differs.
